messages:
alex: Heads-up: proposing a slimline rebuild of our runtime base images next week. Objectives: drop pkg managers, shrink rootfs ~45%, add deterministic build flags, cosign attestations via GCP KMS, and tighter runtime seccomp profile.

maria: Nice. Do we have a preflight checklist for RBAC and audit forwarding? Last time we missed some KMS admin logs.

cj: RBAC checklist draft: - pipeline SA: roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier + storage.objectViewer (for artifacts) - deployer SA: verify permission only (no key access) - emergency-rotation role for on-call with kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToSign? We'll iterate.

olivia: Important: Splunk ingestion needs the cosign attestation predicate and KMS key event (SignAs) forwarded to security-index with retention tags. I'll add a validation job after we flip.

security-bot: vuln-scan: latest baseline flagged openssh dep in previous tag (medium)  re-scan after rebuild.

sre-lee: Runtime checklist: enable read-only rootfs, drop CAP_SYS_PTRACE, enable userns remap and run as non-root. Also test for binary path changes breaking probes.

alex: Rollout idea: canary by region instead of %: start staging-eu -> staging-us -> prod-noncritical -> prod-critical. Keeps blast radius smaller for env-specific bugs.

maria: Good call. Also add validation that old sigs still validate with new key versions for 72h. We need to ensure verifier trusts both keys during transition.

cj: Implementation note: cosign uses a public key pointer; for KMS we can publish a separate 'trusted-root' metadata file in GCS that contains allowed key versions. During rotation we append new version then remove old after grace window.

olivia: For compliance, capture SBOM (CycloneDX) and cosign predicate into artifact metadata. Set retention = 1 year and immutable.

alex: Incident scenario: what if cosign verification fails at deploy time? We should auto-block rollout and open incident, but also provide a fallback to previous image with an automated rollback. Add alert on >0.5% failed verifications in 10m.

sre-lee: Agree. I'll add alert and a runbook step: 1) pause rollout 2) check KMS key versions 3) check artifacts for missing attestation 4) rollback.

maria: Who will update the build pipeline? I can submit PR for the Dockerfile changes + cosign step. Need CJ to touch IAM and Olivia to confirm log forwarding.

cj: I'll make an IAM PR and preflight script. Preflight will check: `gcloud projects get-iam-policy` for pipeline SA, test cosign sign+verify in a sandbox, and validate KMS audit logs exist.

olivia: I'll deploy a tiny Splunk forwarder test that listens for SignAs and cosign predicate insert events and fail CI if not found.

deploy-bot: Planned job: slimline-base-rebuild-canary -> 2026-03-06T01:30Z. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/rebuild-runbook#slimline.

security-bot: note: lock down build containers to ephemeral credentials only.

alex: OK pulling owners: @maria build + pipeline, @cj IAM + preflight, @olivia audit forwarding + SBOM retention, @sre-lee monitoring & rollback automation. I'll open tracking ticket and tag you all. Quick q: any objections to region-based canary?

maria: no objections. Let's make sure tests include config that fails fast if UID != expected (some images broke last time).

olivia: One more: encryption-at-rest for artifact metadata must use the same KMS keyring; audit must reference key id. I'll include that in the Splunk schema.

alex: Great. If nobody objects I'll kick off PRs today and schedule a dry run in staging tomorrow. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll post PR link when ready.
